description: A to-do list where each person manages their own tasks.

fields.name: done
fields.description: false at first; set by completing

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: the owner, from the X-User-Id header

endpoints.summary: List the caller's tasks (all tasks for an admin)

rules: user_id is set from the X-User-Id header when the task is created.
A user can get, change, complete and delete only their own tasks; another user's task returns 403. An admin can access every task.
GET /tasks returns only the caller's own tasks for a user, and every task for an admin.
A new task has done false; completing it sets done to true.
Completing a task that is already done returns 409.
title cannot be empty; reject with 422.
